issues.title: WIN-051.c4 H0 (carry-over c3): tidal coefficient N2/M2 ≈ 3e should be (7/2)e
issues.description: WIN-051.c4 H0 carry-over from c3: detail_evidence reads 'N2/M2 ≈ 3e for small eccentricities, yielding e ≈ 0.063 (close to the actual e ≈ 0.0549)'. The correct first-order coefficient from Darwin-Doodson tide-generating-potential expansion is (7/2)·e, not 3·e. Re-verified numerically: Doodson Table II gives M2=0.90812, N2=0.17387 (ratios), so N2/M2=0.1914; actual e=0.0549; (7/2)×0.0549=0.192 which matches perfectly (0.17 vs 0.19 — the 3e gives e≈0.064 which is 16% off). The CONCLUSION ('close to the actual') survives — just the coefficient and the derived e estimate both need correcting.
issues.disposition: ROUTE-TO-ANALYST: verify Darwin-Doodson coefficient (7/2)e from Doodson 1921 Table II, then patch detail_evidence: '3e' → '(7/2)·e', 'e ≈ 0.063' → 'e ≈ 0.054'. Assign to analyst.

issues.disposition: ROUTE-TO-ANALYST: add preemptive defense against gear-motion angular-velocity argument. Need to show that (a) the dome publishes no gear-motion equation that independently predicts N2/M2=0.19, and (b) any gear mechanism producing this ratio would itself require a physical eccentricity-analog.
